spec.title: A repository map in every opening brief
spec.problem:
Planning and plan review made 442 file reads re-discovering the codebase. Add a module `graph_engineering/repomap.py` (standard library only) after Aider's repo map: for tracked Python and JavaScript/TypeScript files, extract top-level symbols with regular expressions and rank files by the ticket's words found in them and by the import graph (a file imported by many files ranks higher). Public interface: `symbols(text, suffix) -> list[str]` (top-level def/class for .py, skipping names starting with '_'; export/function/class/const/let/var for JS, in order, without duplicates); `resolve(source, spec, files) -> str | None` (a relative JS import like './util' or a Python relative import like '.base', resolved to a tracked file in `files`); `build(root, query='', budget_chars=4500) -> str`, one line per file as `path: Sym1, Sym2`, most relevant first, never longer than budget_chars. `prompts.project_brief(root, memory='', query='')` should include the map under a heading containing 'Files most related to this task' when a query is given, and not otherwise.

Environment: commands already run inside an OS sandbox here, and macOS cannot nest one, so tests that use the sandbox (tests/test_gates.py, test_mining.py, test_review_findings.py, test_tools_sandbox.py, test_workflow.py) fail in this environment whatever the change. The test command runs the hermetic test files only (test_agent, test_context, test_interfaces, test_publish, test_repomap); put new tests there.
acceptance_criteria: repomap.symbols and repomap.resolve behave as described for JS and Python
A file containing the ticket's words ranks first; a file imported by several files ranks above an unrelated leaf
project_brief includes the map only when a query is given
